name: ucdavis-proteomics-core-pipeline
description: UC Davis Proteomics Core pipeline — end-to-end proteomics search + differential expression from raw mass-spec data. Detects DIA/DDA + instrument, auto-installs a pinned toolchain, and searches with data-derived parameters: DIA data with DIA-NN; DDA data with Sage (ordinary tryptic Orbitrap) or FragPipe (timsTOF DDA-PASEF and non-specific-enzyme DDA); Radiant or FragPipe's DIA route on request. Then limpa/limma DE, with a written analysis report, full reproducibility bundle, and tidy session packaging. Defaults are derived locally from the data; nothing is downloaded as a workflow at run time.
